answer: A tight ring of 87 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the nebula calculation reruns each epoch, the island weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the crystal settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 64% independent neighbours on the funding graph.
